absences: No buyer deal (PPA, MOU, LOI, contract, site selection) dated 2026-11-24 to 2026-11-26 surfaced in three date-targeted searches; the Thanksgiving-week window is empty on this pass.

Eielson (opportunities eielson): the DAF June 2026 newsletter PDF and the eielson.af.mil release returned HTTP 403 on fetch; the NOITA status and NRC/contract milestone dates could not be read from a primary page, so no check was written.

Buckley (opportunities anpi-buckley): Radiant's Kaleidos release page returned HTTP 403; search summaries say first delivery to Buckley by 2028 and a DOE second HALEU allocation on 2026-07-23, but no fetched primary page confirms them, so no check was written.

DOME (opportunities dome): shipped text says 'not yet fueled'. The energy.gov DOME page (last updated 2026-04-08) does not say whether fueling has started, and no November 2026 source was found. No verdict written.
Equinix-Radiant (opportunities equinix-radiant): no site, host or commissioning date for the 20 Kaleidos units was found in 2026 sources; the deposit reading is settled and was not re-flagged.

JBSA ANPI (search summary only): KSAT quotes an executive pointing to on-base power in 2029, while the Antares release says 2028 or earlier. The 2029 figure is from a search summary and was not fetched, so it is not a correction.
Eielson NOITA date: one search summary dates the notice to 2025-08-31, while the shipped row and the settled reading use 2025-06-11. Not re-flagged; the settled reading stands.
